item.description:
What's New

  • None this version

Fixes

  • Tilt Down and Tilt Up now move only the selected points: the inner end stays, the outer end moves
  • Drawing over part of a saved curve, like extending it to 20k, no longer renames it My Curve or changes the curve away from your stroke

Known Issues

  • None known

What's New

  • My Presets keeps your own starting curves, out of Smaart's list: right-click a curve and Save as User Preset
  • New from Preset in the sidebar is now Presets
  • Tilt Down and Tilt Up lean part of a curve: the left selected point stays, the right end moves
  • Shift-Option-left and right nudge the selected points a small step
  • Offset in the right sidebar is now called Level
  • Shift-click Bend, Tilt, Flatten or Level for a smaller step
  • Cmd-Shift-up and down shift the whole curve 0.1 dB
  • Cmd-Shift-left and right extend the point selection
  • Shift-left and right move the graph down and up
  • Cmd-C copies a curve, Cmd-V pastes it back

Fixes

  • Pasting or opening a Smaart RTA trace at SPL levels now lands at the right level for your TF Ref
  • Floating Trace updates more smoothly
  • Changing Smoothing on a floating RTA no longer makes the line jump and slide back
  • With the library list scrolled down, ticking an overlay or saving a curve no longer moves the list

Known Issues

  • None known

What's New

  • Bend Down and Bend Up arc the selected points between the outer two, a little more each press
  • Shift-Option-up and down nudge the selected points 0.1 dB
  • With every point selected, Option-up and down show in Offset, like Cmd-up and down
  • Scale button picks the TF dB range; TF now opens at +42 to -42, or +30 to -30 in Split
  • RTA shows a line every 6 dB, like Smaart
  • Zoomed all the way out, the frequency labels are Smaart's octaves, 31.5 to 16k
  • Floating Trace can show a saved TF target behind a live TF trace
  • Smooth rounds off small wiggles in a curve, a little more each press
  • Right-click a curve in the library to rename it
  • Click Scale, Smoothing, Blanking or Target in the Floating Trace bar to pick from a list
  • One Haystack preset now sets its own lift and flat-from frequency
  • The menu bar no longer lists recent curves; float a saved curve from the library
  • The menu bar icon flashes green when Smaart connects and red when the connection fails

Fixes

  • An RTA grabbed at 1/6, 1/12, 1/24 or 1 Oct now sits at the right level in Smaart
  • With Smoothing Off on an RTA, Grab is greyed out; pick a Smoothing first
  • A TF curve switched from an RTA curve and saved now shows up in Smaart
  • Saving over a curve with only its capitals changed now renames it to match
  • When zoomed in, or with a TF curve up to 42 dB from 0, loading no longer shifts its levels
  • The Save box can no longer get lost behind the window

Known Issues

  • None known

What's New

  • Floating Trace: float a live Smaart trace in a see-through window over other apps, like the EQ page in LA Network Manager
  • Stretch it, or nudge it with the arrow keys, until its guides sit on the other app's graph, then lock it and click straight through
  • Blanking hides a live TF trace wherever coherence falls below the percentage you pick
  • Invert flips the trace upside down in magenta, Hold freezes it, and Show hides it without closing it
  • Right-click a library curve and choose Float This Curve to float a saved curve
  • Level, Scale and Smoothing set the floating trace's height, dB range and smoothing, and Scale is remembered for each app
  • The floating trace shrinks to fit small EQ graphs, with its controls and name underneath
  • Lock ties the floating trace to the window underneath: it moves with that window and hides while another window covers it
  • A menu bar icon lets you connect to Smaart, float a live trace or a recent saved curve, and control it without the editor
  • Live Grab is now Live Trace: the trace moves live on the editor graph, and Grab makes it your curve point for point; Grab to Editor does the same from the floating trace
  • Closing the editor window keeps Target Trace running in the menu bar
  • Lots of small interface improvements

Fixes

  • Quitting after a REW export now still warns about unsaved changes
  • Typing a point's Freq or Level now waits for Enter before moving anything, and Esc no longer deselects
  • Curves with more than 200 points now show their points instead of just the line
  • Undo after saving under a new name no longer brings back the old name
  • Point Spacing Apply with nothing to change no longer adds an undo step
  • The Live Trace list now shows every measurement straight after connecting
  • New windows open wide enough to show every toolbar button

Known Issues

  • None known

What's New

  • Hold Option and drag to move the graph in any direction, up and down as well as left and right
  • Option with a two-finger scroll or the scroll wheel moves the graph too
  • New from Preset is now a button at the top of the sidebar
  • New from Preset is also in the File menu
  • Quitting or closing the window with unsaved changes now asks first

Fixes

  • Smaart trace files that use comma decimals now import

Known Issues

  • None known
• Saving a curve under a new name now renames the curve in the editor to match

• Live Grab: connect to a running Smaart and pull a live RTA or transfer function trace straight into the editor as an editable target curve
  • Import Smaart ASCII trace exports: open the file, drop it on the graph, or copy in Smaart and paste with Cmd+V
  • Flatten Selected (Cmd+F): select a rough section and press to ease it toward a straight line
  • Hold Cmd+Up or Cmd+Down to keep offsetting the curve
  • The editor warns you if the file behind your loaded curve is deleted
  • Smaart loads target curves when it starts. To see a newly saved curve in a running Smaart, use Import in its Target Curves window, or restart Smaart

• Open a .crv from Finder: double-click a curve, or drop one on the app icon, to load it
  • In the library's All view, a curve can now be dragged to the last spot in its group (previously it snapped back)
  • Point Spacing "Restore" is now reliable after you load or switch a curve, and it resets the offset correctly
  • Holding Option+arrow against a limit no longer wipes your undo history
  • Pressing T or S while drawing with the pencil no longer mixes up the curve
  • The D pencil shortcut no longer gets swallowed after typing in a text field
  • Right-click library actions no longer act on the wrong curve if the list refreshes while the menu is open
  • Library order is kept safe if the folder index cannot be written
  • After closing Split View, Shift+arrow zoom no longer targets the hidden preview

• Overlays now match Smaart: each overlay sits at its own saved offset and shows its own saved tolerance band (TF only)
  • Overlay Offset: shift all overlays together to compare curve shapes (view only, never saved)
  • Match type now also focuses the library list to the curve you are editing; turn it off to browse and filter freely
  • OVERLAYS panel tidied: Show toggle on the title row, Tolerance is now a show/hide toggle

• Wider point range: 16 Hz to 22 kHz (was 20 Hz–20 kHz)
  • Smooth drag-reorder for the curve list, plus right-click Move to Top/Up/Down/Bottom
  • New view-only ± dB tolerance band on overlays, and overlay controls grouped into one panel
  • Grid view now resets on launch
  • Redo (Cmd+Shift+Z)
  • Help menu: built-in Guide & Keyboard Shortcuts
  • Undo now covers everything, not just points
  • Better file handling: banding round-trips, legacy files load, missing folder offers a re-pick

item.title: Version 1.0.1
item.description: Fixes incorrect A and C frequency weighting at 0 Hz.
